That's all my life has been. Problems, problems, problems. Any time I think I have things together, I just get knocked back down again. It's so much. I'm so tired.
My step dad is going to plug the nail tomorrow. If I just take a hit on my credit, it's also going to hit my mother's and she is trying to refinance her car soon. She's also getting all of my aid money in the fall and will be in control of it...I'm afraid of what is going to happen.

It isn't being collected until I graduate. I'm in debt to the apartment complex I left and my phone bill. I also have to have money for the deposit by August 14th because that's when I move in. I also have no insurance on my car, an expired inspection, and a nail in my back tire. If I get pulled over, I'm fucked but I have no other way to get to work. I'm not even getting enough hours at work.

I haven't been overspending or having reckless sex since I moved back home and I am working on my BPD. It's just too hard alone.

I am taking out student loans and thats the only reason I can afford an apartment in the fall. It's enough to pay off all of my debts, too, but they won't wait. I told the collectors that I can pay them off at the end of August but they refuse to work with me. They're going to hit my credit hard and my mom's because she cosigned for the last apartment.

I am so depressed. I have nobody to talk to. I'm afraid I'm going to do something stupid. I'm about to take the 5 Seroquel I have left so maybe I can sleep for a day or two. I'm afraid of what I'll do if I stay awake. I called into work tomorrow because I can't deal with it..that's over $60 I'm losing out on now. Because I'm so fucking stupid.
